structuredContent.scoreRationale: The score is set by the most severe finding (high); 4 findings (1 high, 3 medium) count toward it.
structuredContent.summary: The contract sets a fixed monthly service fee of 1,850,000.00 TL plus VAT, adjusted annually by the previous year's inflation rate. The employer can unilaterally reduce the monthly fee by up to 20% for perceived service quality issues without recourse. The employer may terminate the contract at any time with 60 days' notice without paying compensation. The contractor must maintain a minimum of 64 personnel and cannot transfer staff to other contractors of the employer for two years post-contract. The contractor bears all personnel-related liabilities and insurance responsibilities, with employer liability capped at three months' fees.

risks.title: Counterparty's unilateral termination right
risks.finding: The employer may terminate the contract unilaterally without cause and without compensation by giving sixty days' written notice.
risks.evidence: The employer may terminate the contract unilaterally without cause and without compensation by giving sixty days' written notice.
risks.quote: İşveren, sözleşmeyi gerekçe göstermeksizin ve tazminat ödemeksizin altmış gün önceden yazılı bildirimle feshedebilir.

risks.title: Penalty clause
risks.finding: In case of confidentiality breach, the violating party pays a penalty of 2,000,000.00 TL.
risks.evidence: In case of confidentiality breach, the violating party pays a penalty of 2,000,000.00 TL.
risks.quote: Gizlilik ihlâli hâlinde ihlâl eden taraf 2.000.000,00 TL cezai şart öder.

risks.title: Automatic renewal
risks.finding: The contract automatically renews for one year under the same conditions unless terminated in writing 180 days before expiration.
risks.evidence: The contract automatically renews for one year under the same conditions unless terminated in writing 180 days before expiration.
risks.quote: Sözleşme, süre bitiminden yüz seksen gün önce yazılı olarak feshedilmedikçe aynı şartlarla bir yıl uzar.

risks.title: Liability limitation or waiver
risks.finding: The employer's liability under this contract does not exceed the total service fee of the last three months.
risks.evidence: The employer's liability under this contract does not exceed the total service fee of the last three months.
risks.quote: İşverenin bu sözleşmeden doğan sorumluluğu, son üç aylık hizmet bedeli toplamını aşamaz.

risks.title: Employer's unilateral right to reduce payment by up to 20% without dispute
risks.finding: The employer can reduce the monthly service fee by up to 20% at their sole discretion for any perceived service quality deficiency, with no right for the contractor to dispute this decision, posing a significant financial risk.
risks.evidence:
2.3. The employer may make a deduction of up to 20% of the fee in the month when the service quality is found insufficient.
2.4. The decision on the deduction is at the discretion of the employer and does not give rise to the right to object.
risks.quote: İşveren, hizmet kalitesini yetersiz bulduğu ayda bedelin %20'sine kadar kesinti yapabilir.

risks.title: Restriction on contractor personnel employment post-contract
risks.finding: Contractor personnel are prohibited from working for any other contractor of the employer during the contract and for two years after, potentially limiting workforce flexibility and increasing personnel management risks.
risks.evidence: 3.4. The contractor's personnel cannot work for another contractor of the employer during the contract period and for two years after its termination.
risks.quote: Yüklenici personeli, sözleşme süresince ve bitiminden sonraki iki yıl boyunca işverenin başka bir yüklenicisinde çalışamaz.

recommendations: Negotiate to limit the employer's unilateral right to reduce payments or introduce a dispute resolution mechanism.
Seek to include compensation provisions for early termination without cause by the employer.
Clarify and possibly reduce the post-contract employment restriction on contractor personnel to avoid workforce issues.
Consider negotiating higher employer liability limits to better protect the contractor against damages.
advisorQuestions: Can the employer's unilateral fee reduction be challenged or reviewed?
What compensation, if any, is payable upon early termination by the employer?
Are there exceptions or limitations to the post-contract personnel employment restriction?
